$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/inventory.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (and the worker, in the tenant's system context: the handler that values the floor's moves) writes locations, goods receipts, lots, hides, stock moves and valuations through apps/factory-api's modules/inventory, always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies and sites their grants reach. The floor (factory_floor_runtime) works on its OWN site's stock only (every table it reaches has a site key): it reads the locations, receives goods (receipts, their lines, lots and hides one by one, B-W1-33), changes a hide's state (cutting, B-W1-40) and posts stock moves (receipts, issues to a work order, returns, transfers, B-W1-39); it never releases a lot and never reads a value: no table it inserts into has a cost column (the generated isolation tests insert every column of a copy), and the valuation ledger is not granted to it at all (plan A1 §2.2, §2.6). Portal and link sessions read nothing here. StockMove and StockValuation are append-only (`@append-only`; the …_supply_guards triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login): no role updates or deletes them. Nobody deletes a location (archived), a receipt (cancelled or reversed), a lot (rejected) or a hide (scrapped); the office deletes only the lines of an OPEN receipt. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Location.about: The office keeps each site's location tree and archives empty locations; a SUBCONTRACTOR location (W2a) names the workshop that holds it (partyId; no partner role reads it). The floor reads its own site's locations (bin labels, scans).

GoodsReceipt.about: The office or the receiving site's floor opens a goods receipt, posts it once its moves are in the ledger, cancels an open one; the office reverses a posted one.

GoodsReceiptLine.about: The office or the receiving site's floor writes the lines of an OPEN receipt; the office deletes one.

Lot.about: The office or the receiving site's floor makes a lot at receipt (in QUARANTINE, or RELEASED when it needs no test). Only the office records the Cr VI result and releases, rejects or blocks a lot (QHS-029, SCM-117).

Hide.about: The office or the site's floor receives hides one by one into a lot and changes a hide's grade, shade, thickness, defects and state (cutting); its tag and measured area never change.

StockMove.about: The office and the site's floor post stock moves and read the site's ledger (balances are sums of it). Nobody changes or removes a move: a mistake is a reversal or an adjustment.

StockValuation.about: The office values its moves in the same command, and the worker (system context) values the floor's moves after their event; the office reads the values (stock value, year-end count). Office only: costs. Nobody changes or removes a row.
